name: Phase 10
edition: 40th Anniversary card game, instruction sheet HHR41

setup.text: Choose a dealer. Give each player a Phase Reference Board and a Phase Tracker set to Phase 1.
Shuffle and deal 10 cards face down to each player.
Put the rest face down as the draw pile and turn the top card over beside it to start the discard pile.
The player to the dealer's left goes first; play runs clockwise.

steps: Draw one card, from the draw pile or the top of the discard pile.
Lay down your Phase if you hold all of it.
If your Phase is down, 'hit': add cards from your hand to any laid-down Phase they fit.
Discard one card to end your turn.

round_end: The round ends when someone gets rid of their last card.
Everyone who laid down their Phase this round moves on to the next one; everyone else repeats the same Phase.
The deal passes to the left.
end: The first player to complete Phase 10 at the end of a round wins.

scoring.text: The player who went out scores 0. Everyone else scores the cards left in hand: 5 for each 1–9, 10 for each 10–12, 15 for each Skip, 25 for each Wild. Low totals are better.

tiebreak: If several players finish Phase 10 in the same round, the lowest total wins. If still tied, those players replay Phase 10 and the first to go out wins.

missed.text: The ten Phases, in order: 2 sets of 3; 1 set of 3 + 1 run of 4; 1 set of 4 + 1 run of 4; 1 run of 7; 1 run of 8; 1 run of 9; 2 sets of 4; 7 cards of one colour; 1 set of 5 + 1 set of 2; 1 set of 5 + 1 set of 3.
You need the whole Phase in hand before laying it down, and you get credit as soon as it is down, even if you don't go out.
A Skip is played in front of the player you choose; it counts as your discard. It can never be picked up from the discard pile or used in a Phase.
A Phase may use any number of Wilds as long as it has at least one numbered card. A played Wild stays where it is for the round.
If the dealer's first discard is a Skip, the first player is skipped.

unverified: The 2–6 player range is taken from the six reference boards in the contents list; the sheet does not state a range in its text.
